messages:
nina_fin: Flagging PulseGrid invoices — looks like reserved commit usage duplicated across regions after an HA failover. Total disputed = USD 4,560 across INV-2026-318 and INV-2026-319. Can we offer provisional credit while we investigate?
omar_acct: cc @kevin_sales @maya_platform. They want the credit to avoid dunning.
kevin_sales: I'll hold payment conversation but need a quick ETA. Can we do provisional for up to USD 4.6k?
maya_platform: Need commit tag + metering samples and any vendor/cloud-side ingest events. Sometimes the cloud partner resends meter batches after retries.
nina_fin: Commit=rw-pulse-q2. Metering snippet: ```
2026-05-22T09:41:12Z commit=rw-pulse-q2 node=us-central1-a tokens=180K reserved=true
2026-05-22T09:41:20Z commit=rw-pulse-q2 node=europe-west1-b tokens=170K reserved=true
2026-05-22T09:41:35Z commit=duplicate node=us-central1-a tokens=12K reserved=true source=partner-ingest
```
gcp-ingest-bot: Notice: partner-ingest retry window 09:41:30-09:41:37 had 3 replays for project pulsegrid-id. See logs: https://gcp.internal/logs/pulsegrid/ingest/2026-05-22
maya_platform: That 'duplicate' tag is from partner replay. I can backfill attribution to remove replayed tokens but we need vendor confirmation for replay counts.
sam_revops: Provisional credit approved up to USD 4,560. GL: 5400 (Provisional SLA credits). Reason: "pending vendor replay attribution". Please open BLG-9995 and attach evidence.
omar_acct: Opened BLG-9995 and uploaded meter extracts + invoice PDFs. Notified vendor support with request ID VND-4432 to confirm replays. @kevin_sales can you send an interim note to PulseGrid offering provisional hold and ETA 72h?
kevin_sales: Will do now. I'll note provisional hold for USD 4,560 and explain we are validating partner replay counts.
gcp-ingest-bot: Vendor VND-4432 response: partner reported 11 replayed batches; vendor-ack log attached.
maya_platform: Ran backfill against metering; reprocessed 7,402 events. Replay attribution removes 10,900 tokens; proposed credit USD 3,980. Pushing reconciliation to BLG-9995.
sam_revops: Reviewed audit. Approve final credit USD 3,980. Post GL 5400 journal and issue credit memo.
mar_acct: Posted credit memo USD 3,980 against INV-2026-318 and INV-2026-319; customer acknowledged and will resume payment. BLG-9995 -> closed.
billing_bot: BLG-9995 closed: provisional 4,560 -> final 3,980; GL 5400; audit: https://redwood.internal/ops/billing/BLG-9995/audit
